text:
Yes. Hansen GFC (version GFC-2025-v1.13) mapped about 81.3 ha of tree-cover loss in 2021 within the property. That is roughly 2.23% of its 3,643.5 ha. The finding is corroborated: later years of the series were observed, and the JRC 2020 forest map agrees on 98% of the event area.

Context: about 68.1 ha of the loss area is mapped as planted forest (Pinus elliottii and Pinus taeda), 13.2 ha lies outside mapped forest, and none is native forest. Separately, another 37.3 ha of loss occurred in patches under 0.5 ha, which are not counted as an event.

Limits: Hansen loss includes any stand replacement, such as plantation harvest. This result does not establish deforestation, land-use change, the cause, legality, who was responsible, or any compliance status.
